briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 5 escalate frontier model race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny define the landscape as adoption accelerates across sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with enhanced multi-agent capabilities while Anthropic launches Claude 5. Google DeepMind and xAI push new scaling frontiers; Meta open-sources Llama 4.5 variants. DeepSeek releases competitive R2 model targeting enterprise use.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with new patents filed for automotive CAN bus and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC and Samsung ramp 2nm AI chip production. Microsoft and Google announce major data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. NVIDIA Blackwell supply tightens as demand surges.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols like DialectForge become the default security layer before 2028?
